option.name: originalContent
option.value:
<odoo>
<!-- Tree View --> <record id="view_crm_lead_snapshot_tree" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">crm.lead.snapshot.tree</field> <field name="model">crm.lead.snapshot</field> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <tree> <field name="snapshot_date"/> <field name="lead_id"/> <field name="stage_id"/> <field name="expected_revenue"/> <field name="probability"/> </tree> </field> </record>
<!-- Search View --> <record id="view_crm_lead_snapshot_search" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">crm.lead.snapshot.search</field> <field name="model">crm.lead.snapshot</field> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <search> <field name="lead_id"/> <field name="stage_id"/>
<filter name="filter_week" string="This Week" context="{'group_by': 'snapshot_date:week'}"/> </search> </field> </record>
<!-- Correct Parent Menu (CRM → Reporting) --> <menuitem id="menu_crm_lead_snapshot_root" name="Lead Snapshots" parent="crm.crm_menu_crm_sales" sequence="90"/>
<!-- Action --> <record id="action_crm_lead_snapshot" model="ir.actions.act_window"> <field name="name">Lead Snapshots</field> <field name="res_model">crm.lead.snapshot</field> <field name="view_mode">tree,search</field> </record>
<menuitem id="menu_crm_lead_snapshot" name="Lead Snapshots" parent="crm.crm_menu_sales" action="action_crm_lead_snapshot" sequence="10"/>
</odoo>
